D-12.requiredScope: Owner/deadline register, monotonic clock/UTC anchor and provisional SyncMarker interface only; no final cross-device synchronization protocol or acceptance decision.

developmentTasks.title: Configuration and geometry foundations
developmentTasks.action: Implement validated synthetic rig/scenario/session configuration and pure coordinate/geometry functions. Centralize editable placement, units and frame conventions; reject missing study calibration rather than silently using examples.
developmentTasks.verification: Known geometry, invalid/missing field and frame-conversion tests pass; synthetic fixture values cannot qualify a study rig.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Real dimensions, serial bindings and measured physical registration.

developmentTasks.title: Shared clock and tracking contracts
developmentTasks.action: Implement the monotonic shared clock, UTC startup anchor, validity-bearing tracking interfaces and deterministic test-clock adapters without selecting D-12 synchronization.
developmentTasks.verification: Tests prove one timestamp authority, monotonic ordering and explicit invalid samples; no invented final sync protocol.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Cross-device alignment method, physical trigger timing and clock comparison.

developmentTasks.title: Synthetic tracking source
developmentTasks.action: Implement deterministic scripted motion/dropouts/triggers through the same source interface; preserve raw logged data and keep rendering prediction separate.
developmentTasks.verification: Seeded fixtures repeat; dropout/trigger tests pass; source identifies synthetic mode and requires no SteamVR.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Real tracker serial/reconnect, polling jitter, occlusion and coordinate spikes.

developmentTasks.title: Logging events and target snapshots
developmentTasks.action: Implement versioned sample/event/target/session output with source/config hashes, sequence/drop reporting, safe close and no-overwrite behavior; world target state remains canonical.
developmentTasks.verification: Schema and round-trip checks, forced overflow/failure tests and a measured synthetic soak report pass applicable software criteria.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Study-PC full-load throughput, disk behavior and real-device timing.

developmentTasks.title: Synthetic analysis ingest
developmentTasks.action: Implement schema-aware read-only ingest and summaries from synthetic recordings; retain raw inputs and provenance.
developmentTasks.verification: Known fixture counts, invalid-sample exclusion, scores and hand-computed angular errors agree; unsupported schemas fail clearly.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Pilot-data end-to-end analysis and investigator acceptance.

developmentTasks.title: Rendering operator view and replay
developmentTasks.action: Implement projection, editable synthetic layout, operator diagnostics and replay. A clearly labeled development view may emulate display separation; study mode still requires actual displays and calibration.
developmentTasks.verification: Projection corner tests, replay checks and exercised development UI controls pass; rendering prediction never changes logged pose.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Physical corner rods, head mount, output assignment and performance at target refresh.

developmentTasks.title: Scenario targets shots and scoring
developmentTasks.action: Implement configurable scenario/session definitions, world-space targets, seeded motion/spawn, shot/scoring interfaces and provisional development fixtures; preserve specified scientific invariants.
developmentTasks.verification: Seeded repeatability, known hits/misses, event-derived scoring and invalid condition-order tests pass.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Final D-04 through D-08 and D-16 parameters and study behavior signoff.

developmentTasks.title: Session engine and operator controls
developmentTasks.action: Implement the session state machine, operator controls, abort/rerun and synthetic self-check. SyncMarker is provisional until D-12; study readiness must fail for missing physical requirements.
developmentTasks.verification: Exercise complete synthetic session, abort/restart/failure paths and event coverage; study mode cannot bypass missing calibration/hardware.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Real dry session, final cross-device synchronization and operator procedure validation.

developmentTasks.title: Calibration solvers and development wizards
developmentTasks.action: Implement synthetic pivot/corner/zero solvers and wizard flow with explicit unmeasured data and configurable provisional development thresholds.
developmentTasks.verification: Known transforms recover within declared numerical tolerance; degenerate data fails; generated synthetic calibration cannot enable study readiness.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Measured rig/participant calibration, mounting rigidity, daily laser check and approved D-17 thresholds.

developmentTasks.title: ELTS protocol and simulated link
developmentTasks.action: Implement the specified codec/contracts and mock/null link plus a simulated controller model. Preserve command-only Unity boundaries. Do not deploy to or alter the built apparatus; unavailable protocol details are exact scoped blockers.
developmentTasks.verification: Malformed/version/sequence/timeout/reconnect tests pass against explicit fixtures; no physical safety or actual transport timing claim.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Existing controller code/protocol compatibility, D-03/D-10, physical link, shutdown and safety validation.

developmentTasks.title: Simulated ELTS session integration
developmentTasks.action: Connect session lifecycle to mock ELTS link, abort/reconnect and configurable development WE/NE alternatives without deciding final D-10 or energizing hardware.
developmentTasks.verification: Scripted command/ack/loss/abort sequences behave correctly and are logged; reconnect never silently resumes active operation.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Actual Unity-Jetson integration cycles, physical fail-safes and approved WE/NE behavior.

developmentTasks.title: Development packaging and end-to-end handoff
developmentTasks.action: Package a clearly marked synthetic development build, setup/run instructions, test evidence and hardware follow-up register. Do not label it study-v1.0 or study-ready.
developmentTasks.verification: Run available path-with-spaces, copied-output, synthetic end-to-end and provenance checks; report unavailable second-machine tests explicitly.
developmentTasks.deferredPhysicalEvidence: Actual study-machine portability, full rig soak, pilots, approved freeze and G8 release.

progressSelection.baselineCurrent: Earliest unpassed baseline phase/gate; existing anchor-phase current fields retain their meaning.
progressSelection.execution: Select globally across eligible bootstrap, DEV and explicitly eligible baseline parallel work; in_progress then verification_pending then ready, stable executionOrder tie-break.
progressSelection.completion: Only authorized G8 passage completes the project; DEV completion never closes parent tasks or gates.
